Class ConfigNameCache

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.annotations.compile.ConfigNameCache
public class ConfigNameCache extends Object
A cache for AbstractConfigStructure objects indexed by their class names. This class provides lookup methods for different types of names (ClassName, TypeName, TypeMirror) to efficiently retrieve cached configuration structures.

    • lookupAST

      public Optional<AbstractConfigStructure> lookupAST(TypeMirror mirror)
      Looks up an AbstractConfigStructure by its TypeMirror. This method only works with declared types.
      Parameters:
      mirror - The type mirror to look up
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the AbstractConfigStructure if found, or empty if not found or if the TypeMirror is not a declared type

    • put

      public void put(AbstractConfigStructure ast)
      Adds an AbstractConfigStructure to the cache, indexed by its name. If an entry with the same name already exists, it will be replaced.
      Parameters:
      ast - The AbstractConfigStructure to add to the cache
